description: Pinned OpenHW CV32E40P core using the shared split OBI runtime with machine-timer interrupt irq_i[7]. Its native instruction/data OBI interfaces do not carry bus-error pins; the OBI adapter is therefore declared with error_response=false and rejects backend errors.

resets.release: The upstream core uses the active-low rst_ni port for sequential state; the local harness deasserts it on the declared core clock boundary.

capabilities.evidence: Pinned cv32e40p_core.sv declares split 32-bit instruction/data OBI fields and data_be_o[3:0]. It has no instr_err_i/data_err_i physical pins. The local OBI adapter is single-outstanding and must fail-stop if the backend reports an error that the CPU cannot represent.
